text: As of early 2023, press reported that the MegaFon mobile operator was 100% owned by USM Group, the holding of billionaire Alisher Usmanov.
short: As of early 2023, MegaFon was reported 100% owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Group.

source.name: The Moscow Times (Russian service): «Ростелеком» решил выкупить «Мегафон» у миллиардера Усманова
source.quote: Оператор на 100% принадлежит USM Group и владеет 100% «Скартел» (бренд Yota)
